jobs.title: Data Analyst with GCP
jobs.description: Position: Sr. Data Analyst (Data Discovery & Metrics) Location: Dallas, TX / Austin, TX (Hybrid) Job Description: Mandatory / Must-Have Skills: Data Discovery, Availability & Gap Analysis: Demonstrated ability to discover and assess structured, semi-structured and file-based data across enterprise systems; create inventories, source assessments and gap matrices; and determine whether metric inputs are available, derivable or missing based on grain, coverage, history, quality, lineage and access. SQL, BigQuery & Python: Strong SQL for profiling, complex joins, window functions, aggregation and reconciliation; working knowledge of BigQuery metadata, tables, views, partitioning, clustering and cost-aware analysis; and practical Python skills for profiling, file inspection, comparison, validation and repeatable analytics. Metrics, Modeling & Traceability: Ability to decompose KPIs and financial metrics into source fields, grain, business rules, dimensions, filters, period logic, numerator and denominator; understand facts, dimensions, keys, hierarchies and snapshots; and document source-to-metric lineage, transformations and validation criteria. Source Systems & Data Formats: Experience analyzing Jira, Rally, GitHub, Clarity, Remedy or comparable platforms and working with databases, structured tables, APIs, Avro and delimited flat files, including schema interpretation, source ownership and cross-system reconciliation. Data Quality, Documentation & Delivery: Experience defining completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, timeliness and referential-integrity checks and producing data dictionaries, mappings, profiling reports, gap logs, UAT evidence, Confluence documentation and daily or weekly status reports. Stakeholder Collaboration & Financial Services: Ability to work with metric owners, data owners, business SMEs, architects, engineers and BI developers to resolve gaps and confirm authoritative sources, with experience in regulated financial services and awareness of privacy, access controls, auditability and evidence retention. Looking forward your reply.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Title: Data Engineer Location: Dallas, TX 75252 (Onsite two days per week) Type of Role: Fulltime, Perm Salary: Between $120,000 - $145,000 Work Authorization: Authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for sponsorship (Either now, or in the future)   ROLE SUMMARY The Data Engineer is a technology professional embedded within the Digital Transformation team, supporting Construction Operations and corporate functions through reliable data integration, scalable data pipelines, and well-governed enterprise data. Reporting to the DX manager, this role partners closely with IT, Construction Operations, Finance, and PMO to transform data from core business systems into trusted, accessible datasets that support reporting, analytics, forecasting, and operational decision-making . This role supports data engineering initiatives for our data across ERP and MRP platforms, project management systems, field mobility tools, scheduling systems, financial systems, and construction technology solutions. The Data Engineer designs and maintains integrations and data pipelines that improve project visibility, reporting reliability, data availability, and digital transformation efforts across a capital-intensive construction environment . The position plays a key role in strengthening data governance, improving data quality, automating data movement, and building scalable data infrastructure that enables enterprise growth and operational excellence through our data lake house. Success in the position is achieved through the following duties & responsibilities: Construction Data Pipelines & Integration Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines that support project managers, operations leaders, and executive reporting needs. Integrate data from ERP/MRP, project management, scheduling, field mobility, and financial systems into governed enterprise datasets. Develop and maintain transformations that standardize project, labor, cost, vendor, material, and operational data for downstream use. Technology & Systems Integration Support data integration requirements for system implementations, upgrades, and digital transformation projects. Partner with application owners and vendors to define data interfaces, source-to-target mappings, and integration requirements . Automate recurring data movement and manual workflows through scripting, APIs, orchestration, and reusable data pipelines. Data Platform Engineering & Automation Build and optimize data models, staging layers, and curated datasets that support enterprise analytics and reporting. Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot failures, and improve reliability, scalability, and data processing efficiency. Document data flows, transformations, dependencies, and technical standards to support maintainable and reproducible solutions. Data Governance & Quality Management Collaborate with Technology teams to improve data quality, consistency, lineage, and reliability across enterprise systems. Support master data management initiatives across projects, vendors, materials, labor categories, and other shared business entities. Implement validation, reconciliation, and monitoring controls that strengthen enterprise reporting and trusted data use. Business Partnership & Communication Work directly with Construction Operations, Finance, HR, and corporate leadership to translate business and reporting needs into data solutions . Partner with analysts and data consumers to deliver well-defined, accessible datasets and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Contribute to change management and adoption efforts associated with new data integrations, reporting tools, and system enhancements.   WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS This role is critical to ensure enterprise technology investments and construction operations are supported by accurate, timely, and reliable data. The Data Engineer strengthens the integration between technology systems and field execution by building trusted data pipelines that enable reporting, forecasting, financial controls, and operational decision-making. By improving integrations across enterprise systems, this role creates a scalable data foundation for predictable project delivery, capital efficiency, and sustainable growth. Requirements Required Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. 3-5 years of experience in data engineering, data integration, or related data platform work . Proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, automation, and troubleshooting. Experience building ETL/ELT data pipelines, integrating APIs, working with relational databases, and implementing modern data engineering practices in Data Warehouse or Lakehouse environments. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure-based data services , or similar cloud-based data platforms. Experience in data modeling and designing scalable data structures to support analytics, reporting, and business intelligence solutions. Strong problem-solving skills with attention to data quality, reliability, and documentation. Experience using Git and CI/CD practices for managing and deploying data engineering solutions. Experience designing and implementing Medallion Architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) to support scalable, governed, and efficient data processing workflows. Experience developing and maintaining Power BI semantic models , reports, and dashboards to support enterprise analytics and reporting. Knowledge of dimensional modeling, star schema design, and semantic layer development for scalable business intelligence solutions. Experience integrating enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and third-party applications to support end-to-end business processes and analytics. Preferred Experience working with ERP, MRP, or construction/project management systems. Exposure to capital project delivery environments or construction operations. Familiarity with Power BI or similar enterprise BI platforms. Experience supporting financial, job-cost, project-controls, or operational reporting data. Knowledge of enterprise data governance and security practices.   CORE COMPETENCIES Enterprise Data Engineering ERP & Systems Integration Data Pipeline Development & Automation Cloud Data Platforms & SQL Data Modeling & Transformation Data Quality, Governance & Reliability Cross-Functional Collaboration Problem Solving & Technical Rigor   SUCCESS METRICS Improved reliability and availability of enterprise data pipelines Faster access to trusted data for Construction and Technology teams Reduction in manual data movement and reconciliation efforts Improved integration across ERP, project, financial, and field systems Improved enterprise data quality, lineage, and reporting consistency Demonstrated contribution to scalable analytics and operational efficiency   About INSPYR Solutions Technology is our focus and quality is our commitment. jobs.title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician -
jobs.description: Description How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer-centric company? You would work with teams of front-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most powerful data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation. AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT’s) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market. We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history! Key job responsibilities Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS) Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA) Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment Technical writing to support change management program Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations. Role may support more than one location/site. Work Schedule Our Data Centers operate 24/7 and require on-site presence. This position offers two shift schedule options: Option 1: Weekend Rotation Days Worked: Sunday - Tuesday, plus every other Saturday Weekly Pattern: Alternates between 3-day and 4-day work weeks Shift Hours: 5:30am - 6:00pm (day shift) OR 5:30pm - 6:00am (night shift) Option 2: Weekday Rotation Days Worked: Wednesday - Friday, plus every other Saturday Weekly Pattern: Alternates between 3-day and 4-day work weeks Shift Hours: 5:30am - 6:00pm (day shift) OR 5:30pm - 6:00am (night shift) Both schedules follow a rotating pattern where you'll work 3 days one week and 4 days the following week. Overtime & Pay Overtime: Time and a half after 40 hours per week Night Shift Differential: 13% additional pay (6:00pm - 6:00am shifts) Maximum Hours: 60 hours per week in total (up to 20 hours of overtime) Physical Requirements Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations: Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection A day in the life This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment. About The Team AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. jobs.description: Description As a Data Engineer you will enable data-driven decision making within the Amazon Web Services Data Center Infrastructure Operations organization. The Infrastructure Operations Team is responsible for planning, implementing, monitoring and continuously improving the global Amazon Data Center infrastructure. The team supports all aspects of the Data Center based organizations, including but not limited to : Safety, Security, maintenance, operations, logistics, engineering and equipment management. jobs.title: Consultant, Data Engineering
jobs.description: SUMMARY Build the pipelines that bring the outside world into the Knowledge & Intelligence layer - the governed knowledge spine that grounds AI agents on verified, provenance-backed facts. You own how data gets in: the contracts with upstream domain teams, the connectors and change-data-capture that move it, and the landing zone it arrives in. This is hands-on data engineering where everything downstream depends on what you bring in - get the source contracts and ingestion solid and every system that reads this data can trust its inputs. What You'll Own Source & publishing contracts. Negotiate schema, freshness SLAs, and change-notice with upstream domain teams - and hold them to it. These contracts are what keep the layer trustworthy. Connectors & ingestion. Build and operate the connectors and change-data-capture that land upstream sources into the lake, reliably and on their freshness SLA. The landing zone. Own the raw landing layer - structure, partitioning, and a clean handoff to the medallion pipeline. Ingestion observability. Know when a source breaks, drifts, or goes stale - before anything downstream does. Grounding discipline. Nothing lands ungrounded; provenance travels with every record from the moment it arrives. Why This Role? You own the front door to the entire layer - every grounded fact starts as something you sourced and landed. Get ingestion right and everything downstream can trust its inputs. This is a greenfield role - you're standing up the sourcing patterns and the contracts from scratch, not inheriting a maintenance queue. High leverage on reliability - the freshness and trustworthiness of the whole layer rests on the inputs you bring in. Essential Requirements: Senior / staff-level, hands-on depth in data sourcing and ingestion - the core discipline of this role. Strong Python - your primary language for building and operating pipelines, connectors, and tooling. A track record of landing diverse upstream sources into a data lake reliably and on their freshness SLA. Proven experience handling data at high volume, with real attention to cost, partitioning, and performance. A provenance mindset - "where did this come from" travels with every record you land. Strong collaboration and stakeholder communication with upstream domain teams. Tech Stack Ingestion takes whatever shape the source needs - depth in one or two matters more than all of them: Sources - REST / APIs • Kafka • Teradata • Oracle • SQL Server • MongoDB • Cassandra • S3-compatible storage (ECS) Move & land - CDC • SQL & DB extract scripts • Airflow • Spark / PySpark • Delta / Iceberg • CSV / JSON / Parquet Compensation Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.
